com.cloudforgeci:cloudforge-api 3.3.0 发布, Bill of Materials (BOM) for CloudForge — import as type pom / scope import.
    Reactor modules: cloudforge-core, cloudforge-api. cloudforge-ministack and
    cloudforge-localstack are managed BOM coordinates but not reactor modules — each lives in its
    own repo (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-ministack, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-localstack), declares
    this pom as its Maven parent, and publishes independently on its own schedule; cloudforge-api's
    dependency on each pins an explicit real release (see 3.2.17/
    3.2.17), not this pom's own in-progress version.
    cloudforge-manager-deployment and cloudforge-manager are also not part of this
    BOM/reactor — split into their own private repos
    (CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager-deployment, CloudForgeCI/cloudforge-manager), each with a
    standalone pom.xml and independent versioning.
    See docs/architecture/cloudforge-sample-bom.template.md and
    docs/architecture/module-boundaries-and-refactor.plan.md.

        Quarkus application's build and make the runtime work in a GraalVM native image:
        they register the tool, artifact and model POJOs the runtime reaches reflectively
        (Jackson and the schema walker), initialize the runtime's threading singletons at
        run time instead of build time, include the skill and catalog resources, honor the
        ServiceLoader files, and fail the build if a concrete Artifact lacks its type alias.
        Nothing here runs at application runtime; nucleo-core carries no Quarkus dependency.

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.73.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

items.title:
io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.53 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.
